title: Incidence of Colon Ischemia in Patients After Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR)
official: Incidence of Colon Ischemia in Patients After Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation (CPR): a Prospective Single-center Epidemiological Incidence Study
summary: Bedside colonoscopy 24-36 hours after successful CPR
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adult patients (≥ 18 years) admitted to the participating department AND
* in-hospital or out-of-hospital cardiac arrest (IHCA, OHCA)

Exclusion Criteria:

* resuscitation period of ≤ 5 minutes
* awake and contactable patients (GCS ≥ 13)
